## Contribution

- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/validate_catalog.py`.
- [ ] This skill contains instructions and static references only.
- [ ] I requested only the reviewed tools the skill needs.
- [ ] I explained when the skill should and should not be used.
- [ ] I bumped the version if I changed an existing skill’s behavior.

### What does this help people accomplish?

Describe the outcome and include one realistic example request.

### What should reviewers pay special attention to?

Call out safety boundaries, external data, and tool access.
